Notify provider for worsening headache or decreased level of consciousness.

patient.name: Robert Hayes
patient.past_medical_history: HTN, hyperlipidemia, type 2 diabetes, smoking history.
patient.social_history: Lives with spouse; former smoker.

timeline.text: Chest pain began 45 minutes ago during exertion and did not resolve with rest.
ECG obtained; pain remains severe; client pale and diaphoretic.
Troponin elevated; STEMI alert activated.
After aspirin/nitroglycerin pain improved but BP fell; cath lab ready.
Post-PCI pain improved; occasional PVCs noted.

ehr.overview: Crushing substernal chest pain radiating to jaw with diaphoresis and nausea.
ehr.history_physical: Pale, diaphoretic, anxious, clear lungs, peripheral pulses present, chest pressure 9/10.

notes.note: Chest pain began 45 minutes ago during exertion and did not resolve with rest.
ECG obtained; pain remains severe; client pale and diaphoretic.
Troponin elevated; STEMI alert activated.
After aspirin/nitroglycerin pain improved but BP fell; cath lab ready.
Post-PCI pain improved; occasional PVCs noted.

orders.order: STEMI alert, aspirin, cardiac monitoring, oxygen per protocol, prepare for emergent PCI.
Nitroglycerin if SBP adequate; heparin per ACS protocol.
Transport to cath lab immediately with monitor/defibrillator available.

diagnostics.result: ST elevation in II, III, aVF with reciprocal ST depression.
ST elevation improved by >50%; occasional PVCs.

mar.frequency: q5 min PRN if SBP adequate
